name: Main::setWarp
summary: Loads warp <L>:\Chine\Data\warp\<name>, mode warp, cross-fade flag

name: Main::setImage
summary: Shows a still by stem: tga, hnm, CD Images, CD Loc; mode still

name: Dial::playDialogue
summary: Waits for sound channel 3, then plays a lip-sync dialogue

name: MyWarp::setAngles
summary: Sets warp view alpha and beta

name: Dial::runDialogue
summary: Lip-sync dialogue player: voice wav, two speakers' SYNC face loops, subtitles if enabled

name: Main::boot
summary: Boot: single-instance mapping, module inits in order, chine.cfg, logo/intro/ANJGEN41 dialogue/itb, menu music

name: Main::resetGlobals
summary: Resets option and state globals to defaults (speed 2, subtitles 1, music 1)

name: Main::showLoading
summary: Loading screen: still Load and text Chargement en cours...

name: Music::startMenuMusic
summary: Starts menu music Allee.zik (local Data\Music then CD), if music option on

name: Main::readConfig
summary: Reads chine.cfg: speed, subtitles, music, save-mode field

name: Main::writeConfig
summary: Writes chine.cfg (four uint32 options)

name: Main::menuDispatch
summary: Menu dispatcher: new game, load, resume, save, visit, quit

name: Main::run
summary: Game: menu, then frames until menu or quit, then credits

name: Main::frame
summary: One game frame: input, script, warp or still draw, cursor, flip

name: Main::handleKeys
summary: Per-frame keys: fps, debug keys, Space interface, Escape

name: Main::scanSaveSlots
summary: Marks which of the 12 save files exist

name: Interface::loadMenu
summary: Loads the main menu: fondtitr background and roug_n/blc_n bullet sprites

name: Interface::mainMenu
summary: Main menu screen: 8 bullets with labels, hover, enable rules; returns the choice

name: Main::WinMain
summary: WinMain: boot, fonts, game loop, shutdown; exits silently when another instance runs

name: Main::playHns
summary: Plays an HNS video full screen; Escape or left click stops; returns 1 if skipped

name: MyMouse::update
summary: Updates cursor position from DirectInput relative motion, clamped to the screen; button states

name: MyWarp::hitTest
summary: Maps the cursor hot point through the warp and searches the place zones

name: MyMouse::getHotPoint
summary: Cursor hot point: top-left plus sprite hot-spot offset or half the sprite size

name: MyScreen::init
summary: Screen init: 640x480 16-bit DirectDraw mode

name: MyScreen::drawDebugInfo
summary: Debug overlay: fps, zone, context, WRP_Alpha/x, WRP_Beta/y, video mode, memory

name: MyWarp::init
summary: Warp init: projection 75.137/50.0, zero view angles, 2048x768x2 warp buffer

name: MyWarp::loadWarp
summary: Loads a warp (HNM6 single frame at 0x44, or TGA fallback) into the warp buffer, then setView

name: MyWarp::updateView
summary: Edge scrolling of the warp view with velocity and 0.8 decay

name: MyWarp::zoomIn
summary: Zoom transition: n frames re-initialising the warp with hfov dropping 1 deg per frame, then restores 75.137

name: MyWarp::turnToPoint
summary: Animates the view 32 frames toward the point (x,y) at 20% per frame, focal 416 px

name: Main::setScene
summary: Sets the current scene handler and switches music by scene

name: Main::runScene
summary: Calls the scene handler: 3 on entry, then 0 each frame

name: Main::loadSprite
summary: Loads a .spr sprite (TGA-like header, key colour, x, y, 16-bit pixels)

name: Main::cdHnmPath
summary: CD path of the Hnm\ video folder

name: Main::cdDataPath
summary: Formats the CD data root <L>:\Chine\Data\

name: Main::checkCd
summary: CD check for disk N: scans drives for disk%d.dat, shows cd prompt until found

name: Main::findCdDrive
summary: Finds the drive letter c..z holding \Chine\Data\disk%d.dat

name: Main::cdPrompt
summary: Insert-CD prompt: shows still cd, Escape aborts, Space waits 4 s and returns

name: Main::pointInRect
summary: Point-in-rectangle test (rect stored y1,x1,y2,x2)

name: Zones::find
summary: Linear search of the current zone list (40-byte records) for a point; returns index or -1

name: Warp::screenToImage
summary: Maps a screen point to warp image (x 0..2047, y = 767 - row) by bilinear blend of the grid

name: Warp::init
summary: Builds the 31x21 projection tables (angles, hypotenuses, vertical coords) from hfov/vfov in degrees; same as upstream Omni3D init

name: Warp::setView
summary: Clamps beta to 0.9*vfov, wraps alpha, fills the 31x41-point 16.16 image-coordinate grid; same as upstream updateImageCoords

name: Warp::render
summary: Renders 640x480 16bpp view from the warp image: 30x40 blocks of 16x16 interpolated from the grid
